decision: Material fixed-budget estimator-recipe effect, not a four-symbol ceiling or a claim about asymptotic optimization. At 4,096 fit parents and 5,120 updates the direct finite-channel recipe gained 0.002138 nat per microscopic face over sampled InfoNCE on 512 separate historical TRAIN audit parents. The public threshold was +0.001.
separate_uncertainties: The 95% paired parent interval on the seed-mean difference was [0.002010,0.002265]; paired seed means 0.002119,0.002599,0.001695 all exceeded the floor. Across three starts the conditional seed t interval [0.001014,0.003262] only narrowly cleared it. These are not joint bounds over new fit banks and starts. Parents, not faces or training seeds, define the physical sampling uncertainty. Audit comprises 3,072,000 individual faces, 6,000 per parent.
hard_scores: Mean audit log gain over the direction-only marginal was 0.016814 direct, 0.014676 contrastive, 0.017377 distilled and 0.017348 fit-only teacher, all nat/face, all with identically development-calibrated hard decoders. With fit-calibrated decoders the largest-rung paired effect was 0.002114 [0.001987,0.002241]. At 256 and 1,024 fit parents, dev-calibrated audit differences were 0.001634 [0.001511,0.001757] and 0.001969 [0.001850,0.002088]. The rungs are nested, not independent repetitions.
capacity: The same architecture copied the new fit-only teacher on 99.84% of development tiles on average. That teacher exceeded direct by 0.000534 [0.000334,0.000734] nat/face on audit, smaller than the estimator practical margin. Separately the architecture copied 99.973%-99.975% of the old published teacher's fit-weighted labels; the old teacher's pooled data overlapped this study, so that result is a fit-only imitation diagnostic, not validation. Neither teacher is provably optimal.
terminal_slope: From 2,560 to 5,120 updates, largest-rung development proper scores rose +0.000204 direct [0.000166,0.000241] and +0.000480 contrastive [0.000410,0.000551]; both failed the 0.0001 plateau threshold. Distillation effectively plateaued (+0.000002). The paired direct advantage shrank over the last checkpoints; longer training might close the gap. No audit-guided extension. Under the same largest-rung wall budget, direct at 2,560 updates vs contrastive at 5,120 still yielded +0.001865 nat/face on development.
bias_and_cost: Largest-rung final train-minus-development hard proper-score differences averaged +0.000052 direct and +0.000047 contrastive, versus +0.001788 and +0.001207 at 256 parents. Per-seed conditional intervals are in 21-learning.csv. All 27 trajectories took about 359 wall seconds total, single-thread BLAS. At the largest rung mean training was 20.3 s direct, 11.2 s contrastive, 7.7 s distilled. One direct gradient sums the exact empirical 24,576,000-face channel via its count table; one contrastive gradient uses 1,024 positives and 15,360 sampled same-J negatives, summing the same soft H. This contrasts concrete recipes, including their statistical work, critic optimization and finite-K bias, not a bound specific to every contrastive estimator.
control: All arms recovered the exact 1.0934101-nat planted four-symbol channel in 640 updates. Gradient directional checks differed from central differences by at most 0.00000330. No new physical configurations.
registration: Design 1036785; public pre-audit lock c7a3e4db85a0657d69e304096dbbdf855ab8705e; 21-prediction.json; 21-lineage.json records fold IDs via digests. Native TRAIN only, distinct native row and (chain_seed,chain_id) per parent; there is historical overlap with older studies, not pristine new physics evidence.
